```{r}

df.raw <- read.csv('Life Expectancy Data.csv')
df.raw <- na.omit(df.raw)
df <- df.raw

cols.to.transform <- c("thinness.5.9.years", 
                       "thinness.1.19.years", 
                       "Population", 
                       "GDP", 
                       "HIV.AIDS", 
                       "under.five.deaths", 
                       "Measles",
                       "percentage.expenditure", 
                       "infant.deaths")

for (col in cols.to.transform) {
  df[[col]] = log1p(df[[col]])
}

(df.numeric <- df[, sapply(df, is.numeric)])
```

```{r}
lapply(names(df.numeric), function(column_name) {
  plot(df.numeric[[column_name]],
       df$Life.expectancy,
       xlab = column_name,
       ylab = "Life Expectancy")
})
```
```{r}
# 1. Define the outlier flagging function (returns TRUE if outlier)
is_outlier <- function(x) {
  if (!is.numeric(x)) return(rep(FALSE, length(x)))
  q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  iqr <- q3 - q1
  return(x < (q1 - 1.5 * iqr) | x > (q3 + 1.5 * iqr))
}

# 2. Map across columns to create an outlier matrix
outlier_matrix <- apply(df, 2, is_outlier)

# 3. Keep rows where the total count of outliers is 0
df.clean <- df[rowSums(outlier_matrix) == 0, ]

nrow(df)
nrow(df.clean)
```

```{r}
df.clean.numeric <- df.clean[, sapply(df.clean, is.numeric)]

lapply(names(df.clean.numeric), function(column_name) {
  plot(df.clean.numeric[[column_name]],
       df.clean.numeric$Life.expectancy,
       xlab = column_name,
       ylab = "Life Expectancy")
})
```
```{r}
lm.full <- lm(Life.expectancy ~ ., data=df.clean)
summary(lm.full)
step(lm.full, direction="backward")
```

```{r}
lm.opt <- lm(formula = Life.expectancy ~ Country + Year + Adult.Mortality + 
    Hepatitis.B + Measles + under.five.deaths + HIV.AIDS + thinness.5.9.years + 
    Income.composition.of.resources + Schooling, data = df.clean)

summary(lm.opt)
```
```{r}
lm.full.numeric <- lm(formula = Life.expectancy ~ ., data=df.clean.numeric)
step(lm.full.numeric, direction="backward")
```
```{r}
lm.opt.numeric <- lm(formula = Life.expectancy ~ Year + Adult.Mortality + infant.deaths + 
    percentage.expenditure + under.five.deaths + Total.expenditure + 
    Diphtheria + HIV.AIDS + GDP + thinness.5.9.years + Income.composition.of.resources + 
    Schooling, data = df.clean.numeric)
summary(lm.opt.numeric)
```
